en: Welcome to my Bike Shop! I only just moved here from Kanto, and not a soul has bought a bike yet.
Say, how would you like a Bicycle? Ride it around Johto and show everyone how great it is!
Really? You'll help me out? In that case, it's yours. No charge!
Ride it everywhere you go! When people ask where you got it, tell them about my shop.
How's the Bicycle? Make sure everyone in Johto sees you on it!
Oh... Well, if you change your mind, I'll be right here.
